ja: 米8月のPPI、前年比5.4%まで加速してた…!ガソリン+4.2%はまだしもディーゼル+24.1%ってすごくない?😳 ECBも0.25%利上げしたし、世界中がインフレと格闘してる感じ。明日のCPIどうなるんだろ #米国株
en: US producer prices jumped 5.4% y/y in August — gasoline +4.2% is one thing but diesel +24.1%?? 😳 and the ECB just hiked another 0.25%. feels like everyone's fighting the same inflation right now. CPI lands tomorrow #investing
